Hot Tub Electrical Requirements

Under NEC Article 680, an outdoor hot tub needs GFCI protection, a disconnect within sight of the tub and at least 5 feet from its inside wall, receptacles at least 6 feet away, and no overhead power lines within 22.5 feet. Your local code edition and the tub's installation manual have the final say, so plan on a permit and a licensed electrician.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
